content.name: Chef Ranveer Singhania
content.title: Executive Chef & Culinary Director
content.bio: With over 22 years of illustrious culinary experience across leading luxury 5-star hotels in India and the Middle East, Chef Ranveer leads The Saffron Lounge with obsessive devotion to heritage recipes, ancient slow-cooking secrets, and soulful hospitality.
content.quote: True Indian royal cooking is not about heavy oil or excessive heat; it is an art of patience, where spices marry over gentle glowing embers to release their most delicate soul.

items.name: Dr. Ananya Trivedi
items.review: The Dal Saffron Bukhara is arguably the best in Gujarat. The charcoal notes are mellow, the creaminess is ethereal, and the acoustic sitar music in the background transforms dinner into a royal celebration.

items.review: We hosted our anniversary dinner in the Private Dining Suite. The personalized service, attention to Jain dietary preferences, and warm hospitality made our family feel like royalty. Unmatched quality.

items.name: Meera & Siddharth Joshi
items.review: From the smoked pink guava mocktails to the melt-in-the-mouth paneer angara and truffle naan, every single bite is pure perfection. Make sure to book your weekend table well in advance!

items.question: Is advance table reservation mandatory?
items.answer: While we warmly welcome walk-in guests whenever seating permits, we strongly recommend advance reservations for weekend dinners (Friday to Sunday) and for our Private Dining Suites to avoid wait times.

items.question: Is the restaurant 100% vegetarian, and do you cater to Jain dietary needs?
items.answer: Yes, The Saffron Lounge is a strictly 100% Pure Vegetarian restaurant. We have an extensive specialized Jain menu prepared in a dedicated area with zero onion, garlic, or root vegetables.

items.question: How do I book a Private Dining Room (PDR) for birthdays or corporate meetings?
items.answer: Our Private Dining Suites accommodate 10 to 45 guests. You can request a suite reservation directly through our online form or message our reservations manager on WhatsApp (+91 98980 12345).

items.question: Is valet parking available at the venue?
items.answer: Yes, complimentary valet parking is available at our main entrance on Sindhu Bhavan Road, Bodakdev for all our dining patrons.

items.question: What are your operating hours?
items.answer: We are open 7 days a week. Lunch is served from 12:00 PM to 3:30 PM, and Dinner from 7:00 PM to 11:30 PM.
